question: Which keyboard shortcut in Microsoft Excel 2016 should you use to insert a new worksheet for Windows 10 operating system?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Shift + F11.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shift + F11** in Microsoft Excel 2016 should you use to insert a new worksheet for Windows 10 operating system.
 
• F11 Creates a chart of the data in the current range.
